ALLOWED_EMAIL.description: The email you sign in to Cozi with. Only this Cozi account can use your server.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Lets your server update itself. [Create the token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/api-tokens&permissionGroupKeys=%5B%7B%22key%22%3A%22workers_scripts%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22edit%22%7D%5D&name=calendar-connector%20updater) in this Cloudflare account, click Review token, then Create token, and paste it here. Type off to skip updates.
